parts.gloss: the world or people of the world

literal: Him who lives elevating his family, being free from faults, the world will surround as a kinsman.
translation: The world will gather around as a close relative to embrace the one who lives free of faults, constantly working to elevate their family.
modern: குற்றம் இல்லாதவனாய் தன் குடியை உயரச் செய்து வாழ்கின்றவனை, இவ்வுலகம் தன் உறவினனாகக் கருதிச் சூழ்ந்து கொள்ளும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the universal respect earned by someone who dedicates their life to the upliftment of their family or community through righteous means. The phrase 'kuṟṟam ilaṉāy' emphasizes that this effort must be free of moral blemishes or dishonest deeds. When a person selflessly elevates their lineage ('kuṭi ceytu') with such integrity, they do not remain isolated; instead, the entire world ('ulaku') embraces them. The world treats them not as a stranger, but surrounds them with the warmth and affection reserved for one's own close kin ('cuṟṟamā').
